label: Trello
description: Kanban-style project boards, lists, and cards.
notes: Auth: AP uses BasicAuth fields (API Key + Token) but sends them as key/token query params, not an Authorization header; mapped to the existing catalog credentials TRELLO_API_KEY + TRELLO_API_TOKEN for consistency. Skipped create_card: live catalog already has trello.createCard and the extra AP props (position, labels, board dropdown) are optional fields Trello rejects/misinterprets as empty strings, so a re-emit would not be strictly richer. Skipped update_card (needsPieceRuntime): run() conditionally includes body keys and 'closed' is a true JSON boolean — blank optionals would clear card fields. Skipped add_card_attachment (needsPieceRuntime): multipart FormData file upload. Dropdown props for boards/lists/labels became plain text ID fields.
